scope: Project template HTTP filenames and UTF-8 BOM preservation through creation, registration, indexing, parser rules and source reopening

before.reproduction: Ran all 19 new cases directly against the pre-fix clients with the prior N88 service change retained. Ten filename cases and five BOM cases failed; four compatibility cases passed.

skipReason: Node/Rust archive interoperability requires VIENTO_TEST_ARCHIVE_BINARY; native archive code unchanged
testEnvironment: Production editor controller and request modules connect to actual local HTTP servers in temporary registered workspaces. The adapter only resolves browser-relative URLs to the test origin; DOM rendering is a fixture. v2/v3 special filenames select the configured template, leaving similar files intact. Five formats retain BOM/CRLF through creation, registration, rebuild and source reopening, with layout equal to the project preview. Missing templates remain retryable, empty files are valid and HTML is rejected. Original manifest/template/document bytes and existing registry records stay unchanged.
